preconditions.description: Number of nodes N is between 1 and 10^6.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= U <= N and 1 <= V <= N for U, V in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two nodes within the range [1, N].
There are exactly N-1 edges, forming a tree.

postconditions.description: The output is the maximum number of connected components achievable.
